inputs.spec_clause_ref: kerml clause 8.2.3.3.3 (TextualRepresentation.md, region_sha256 bab3d052ff107d12) | sysml clause 8.2.2.4.3 (TextualRepresentation.md, region_sha256 ad856c052622d4c0)
inputs.xtext_rule_text:
TextualRepresentation returns SysML::TextualRepresentation :
    ( 'rep' Identification? )?
    'language' language = STRING_VALUE 
    body = REGULAR_COMMENT
;

decision: As KerML 8.2.3.3.3 and SysML 8.2.2.4.3 both state it, so one shared unit. An optional `rep` with an Identification, then `language` and a string naming the language, then the REGULAR_COMMENT body holding the text in that language. The Xtext writes `Identification?` inside the optional group, which is the same language because Identification is nullable.
